_comment: Richter hooks for Claude Code. Install with: richter install hooks --agent claude

_docs.PreToolUse_Bash: Intercepts Bash tool calls before execution. Routes the command through Richter for deduplication, caching, and resource scheduling. Uses the shim name from $TOOL_NAME so Richter can classify and fingerprint the command properly.
_docs.PostToolUse_Bash: Reports the run outcome back to Richter after the Bash command completes. Uses $RICHTER_RUN_ID set by the PreToolUse hook to associate the report with the correct run. Output is suppressed (> /dev/null) to avoid polluting the agent's context.
_docs.Notification: Shows a brief Richter status line in the agent's context on each notification event. Uses --brief mode for a one-line summary that won't disrupt the agent's workflow.
